## Appearance

Davy is a handsome child with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has a single dimple in one of his cheeks, which gives him a comical, lopsided appearance when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a mischievous and disobedient child, often given to making terrible faces, yet he possesses a natural knack for winning love. Highly inquisitive, curious, and practical, he lacks imagination and frequently asks questions that can unnerve others. Though heedless and forgetful, he can display great energetic zeal, and he is described as a reformed character. Sorrow is easily comforted in him by food like plum jam. His ambitions include becoming a storekeeper to keep candy and bananas, and he wants to live to be a hundred years old.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), +7 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as an infant and was brought up without proper guidance before [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brought him and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). A naturally mischievous boy, Davy quickly got into trouble by putting a toad in Marilla's bed and later locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse. When confronted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Davy tearfully promised never to lie again after seeing that he had made her cry. Over time, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) developed a deep affection for Davy despite his constant antics, recognizing his need for direction. Following the death of [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), money was left in trust for the twins, ensuring they could permanently remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew older and left for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Davy frequently sent her letters and confessed his moral struggles and misdeeds to her when she returned home on visits. During one holiday break, Davy convinced [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing, but later confessed his lying to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and sought forgiveness. He continued to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) updated on his schoolwork and antics during her stays at home, and eventually broke the news to her that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was critically ill with typhoid fever.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), +37 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

> “But I tell you there is,” persisted Davy. “It was in that question Marilla taught me last Sunday. ‘Why should we love God?’ It says, ‘Because He makes preserves, and redeems us.’ Preserves is just a holy way of saying jam.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy lives under Anne's authority and guidance at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where he frequently gets into trouble through his unruly antics. Despite his misbehavior, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) treats him with affectionate guidance, correcting his confusion about religious lessons and helping shield him from punishment, such as when she retrieved a toad he hid in Marilla's bed. In return, Davy holds fond affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and tries to amend his behavior when he realizes his actions cause her distress.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +19 more_

- Friend of — affectionate towards her  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)</sub>
- Serves under — under her authority and guidance (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister, who came to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside him. While [Dora](../character/dora.md) is known for her quiet perfection, Davy's mischievous nature leads him to target her in his pranks, such as causing her to fall into a pigpen and locking her in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +22 more_

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) serves as Davy's primary guardian, taking him into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and disciplining him for his constant misbehavior. Davy frequently causes trouble around her—stealing jam, hiding a toad in her bed, and misbehaving during catechism lessons—yet [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintains a fond affection for him because she recognizes his need for guidance.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +15 more_

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)
